<!-- exec replaces the local shell so SSH owns the terminal and ends when it closes.
     EOS runs remote bash commands through an extra PTY. Put the original SSH_TTY
     in raw mode to avoid duplicate echo, then clear and start the authorized CLI.
     Readable data-args attributes double backslashes for Markdown parsing;
     the rendered attribute must contain valid JSON. -->
[lab-terminals]: command:runCommands {.btn .btn-primary data-args='[{"commands":[{"command":"vscode.setEditorLayout","args":{"orientation":0,"groups":[{"size":0.666667},{"size":0.333333,"groups":[{"size":0.333333},{"size":0.333333},{"size":0.333334}]}]}},{"command":"workbench.action.createTerminalEditor","args":{"config":{"name":"Lab shell"},"location":{"viewColumn":1}}},{"command":"workbench.action.createTerminalEditor","args":{"config":{"name":"SSH admin@EOS1"},"location":{"viewColumn":2}}},{"command":"workbench.action.terminal.sendSequence","args":{"text":"exec ssh -t admin@EOS1 \\"bash stty raw -echo -F \\\\$SSH_TTY; clear; exec /usr/bin/RunCli\\"\\r"}},{"command":"workbench.action.createTerminalEditor","args":{"config":{"name":"SSH admin@EOS2"},"location":{"viewColumn":3}}},{"command":"workbench.action.terminal.sendSequence","args":{"text":"exec ssh -t admin@EOS2 \\"bash stty raw -echo -F \\\\$SSH_TTY; clear; exec /usr/bin/RunCli\\"\\r"}}]}]'}

::: {.callout-note}
**Native terminal demo:** first open **SSH terminals**, complete both SSH logins,
then use Run at idle prompts. Shell Run targets editor group 2; EOS Run targets
editor groups 3 and 4. These buttons do not verify terminal names, connections
or the active layout. If a different setup is open, they can send commands to
its terminals instead. They do not wait for authentication or command completion.

The command text is repeated in each button's reference definition above.
Changing a visible snippet does not update its Run action automatically;
update the corresponding `data-args` text too. Snippet IDs are labels for now,
not native VS Code lookup targets. This example adds no JavaScript or extension
code.
:::

**Lab shell**

::: {.grid .align-items-start}
::: {.g-col-10}
```{.bash #native-shell-snippet}
whoami
pwd
uname -sr
```
:::
::: {.g-col-2 .text-end}
[▶ Run][run-native-shell]
:::
:::

**Both EOS devices**

::: {.grid .align-items-start}
::: {.g-col-10}
```{.text #native-eos-snippet}
show version
show running-config
```
:::
::: {.g-col-2 .text-end}
[▶ Run][run-native-eos]
:::
:::

## 🔐 SSH to Nodes {#connect-to-nodes .unlisted .unnumbered}

Each click opens a new terminal and connects as `admin`. Complete any SSH login prompts; the screen clears after login. Logging out closes the terminal.

**Router**

[close-terminal-layout]: command:runCommands {data-args='[{"commands":["workbench.action.focusFirstEditorGroup","workbench.action.closeEditorsInOtherGroups",{"command":"vscode.setEditorLayout","args":{"groups":[{}]}}]}]'}

<button id="terminal-toggle" type="button" class="btn btn-primary">
  Open terminals
</button>

<script>
const button = document.getElementById("terminal-toggle");
let opened = false;

button.addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.getElementById(
    opened ? "terminal-close-action" : "terminal-open-action"
  ).click();

  opened = !opened;
  button.textContent = opened ? "Close terminals" : "Open terminals";
});
</script>
